claim: Elias had worked in Qatar for about three years when a Bangladeshi broker there persuaded him to go to Libya for Italy; his family learned of it only after he reached Libya
His family paid BDT 2,000,000; he died in a Libyan detention camp on 23 March 2026
A man returning after about three years' work in Saudi Arabia met a fellow passenger on the flight home who introduced him to a member of a trafficking ring
Bangladeshi workers dismissed by their company in Russia were approached by brokers at the airport when they tried to fly home, or in Moscow while jobless
Their passports and papers were taken 'for visa renewal', and after signing a contract they were taken to a forest to cut trees before weapons arrived
A Mymensingh man's construction work in Russia stopped after six months; a broker in Moscow offered vineyard work and then Italy, and took BDT 5 lakh
After signing papers in Russian that he could not read he found he had been enrolled in the Russian army
A second broker in Moscow took BDT 500,000 from a worker for a promised move to Italy before he was handed to the Russian army
Students paid the study-abroad firm BSB Global Network BDT 13 lakh to 17 lakh each for Canada and did not get visas or refunds
CID arrested its chairman, Khairul Bashar, on 14 July 2025
CID's inquiry found that for many students the firm had made no application to any foreign university
A woman whose family lost money paid to a Saudi sponsor for 17 visas answered Facebook and YouTube advertisements promising to recover owed money, and lost BDT 10 lakh more
The fraudsters promised to recover the money within 72 hours by supernatural means
Police charged 23 people on 13 July 2026
A Madaripur family paid a broker BDT 2,500,000 for the journey to Italy, then BDT 2,000,000 in ransom and BDT 250,000 said to be for hospital treatment after he was held in Libya; he died there
The family sold all its land to pay
A Bhairab family that contracted with a neighbour for BDT 950,000 to reach Italy had paid about BDT 4,500,000 by August 2025 and was being asked for BDT 2,500,000 more
The first demand, BDT 1,100,000 within one day, came with a torture video about a month and a half after he reached Libya

After paying BDT 20 lakh ransom a family agreed a BDT 16 lakh 'body contract', a guarantee of delivery to Italy however long it took, with food, lodging and fare included; the man died of torture in Libya
A Madaripur family contracted for BDT 2,200,000 and paid BDT 2,000,000 more while the man was held in Benghazi; he was shot dead on a boat on 1 November 2025 and the family was told on 18 November
